h1. DependencyTrack Stack Installation & Deployment Guide

This guide covers the complete installation and deployment of the DependencyTrack stack with PostgreSQL, Borgmatic backups, LDAP authentication, Caddy reverse proxy, and supporting services using Docker Compose.

h2. Architecture Overview

* *Services*: PostgreSQL, DependencyTrack API Server, Frontend, Swagger Editor/UI, Borgmatic backup, Caddy reverse proxy
* *Orchestration*: Docker Compose (single host)
* *Networking*: Local bridge network
* *Storage*: Local named volumes
* *Security*: Environment variables from .env, LDAP/AD authentication, TLS via Caddy

h2. Prerequisites

* Docker Engine and Docker Compose installed
* Deployment server: {{s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com}}
* Network share mounted at {{/mnt/borg-repository}} (for backups)
* LDAP/Active Directory credentials
* OpenSSL for TLS certificates (optional)

h2. Step 1: Prepare Environment File

Create {{.env}} in the project root with all sensitive configuration:

bc.
cat > .env << 'EOF'
# PostgreSQL
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=your-secure-postgres-password

# LDAP / Active Directory
LDAP_SERVER_URL=ldaps://ldap-server:636
LDAP_BASEDN=dc=example,dc=com
LDAP_BIND_USERNAME=ldap-service-account
LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD=ldap-service-password
LDAP_AUTH_USERNAME_FORMAT=%s@example.com
LDAP_ATTRIBUTE_NAME=userPrincipalName
LDAP_ATTRIBUTE_MAIL=mail
LDAP_GROUPS_BASEDN=ou=Groups,dc=example,dc=com
LDAP_GROUPS_FILTER=(& (objectClass=group)(objectCategory=Group))
LDAP_USER_GROUPS_FILTER=(member: 1.2.840.113556.1.4.1941:={USER_DN})

# Borgmatic (Backup)
BORG_PASSPHRASE=your-secure-backup-passphrase
EOF

h2. Step 2: Encrypt and Transfer .env (Optional but Recommended)

h3. Encrypt Locally

Before transferring to the deployment server, encrypt the .env file:

bc.
./resources/scripts/secret_encryptor.sh encrypt .env

This creates {{.env.enc}} using AES-256-CBC encryption. You will be prompted for a passphrase.

h3. Transfer Encrypted File

bc.
scp .env.enc deploy@s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com:/tmp/

h3. Decrypt on Deployment Server

bc.
ssh deploy@s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com

cd /tmp
/path/to/secret_encryptor.sh decrypt .env.enc

# Move to deployment directory
mv .env ~/sbom-uploader/
cd ~/sbom-uploader

# Secure the directory
chmod 700 .

# Verify
cat .env

h2. Step 3: Prepare Network Mount for Backups

Ensure {{/mnt/borg-repository}} is mounted on the deployment server:

bc.
# Check if mounted
mount | grep borg-repository

# If not mounted (NFS example):
sudo mount -t nfs nfs-server:/path/to/borg-repository /mnt/borg-repository

# If not mounted (SMB example):
sudo mount -t cifs //smb-server/borg-repository /mnt/borg-repository -o username=user,password=pass

# Set permissions
sudo mkdir -p /mnt/borg-repository
sudo chmod 700 /mnt/borg-repository

# Verify
ls -la /mnt/borg-repository

h2. Step 4: Configure Deployment

h3. Verify Caddyfile

The reverse proxy configuration should be in {{./Caddyfile}}:

bc.
{
  email your-email@example.com
}

s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com {
  reverse_proxy dependency-track-apiserver:8080
  reverse_proxy dependency-track-frontend:80
  reverse_proxy /swagger/* swagger-ui:8080

  encode gzip
}

h3. Verify Borgmatic Config

Ensure {{borgmatic-config.yaml}} has correct database connection:

bc.
repositories:
  - label: postgres_backup
    path: /mnt/borg-repository
    passcommand: echo "$BORG_PASSPHRASE"

retention:
  keep_daily: 7
  keep_weekly: 4
  keep_monthly: 12

postgresql_databases:
  - name: dtrack
    hostname: postgres
    port: 5432
    username: dtrack
    password_command: echo "$DB_PASSWORD"
    options: null

h3. Prepare TLS Certificates (If needed)

If using self-signed certificates:

bc.
mkdir -p certs
openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \
  -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem \
  -subj "/CN=s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com"

h2. Step 5: Deploy the Stack

h3. Pull Latest Images

bc.
docker-compose pull

h3. Start Services

bc.
docker-compose up -d

This will:
* Create local named volumes
* Create local bridge network
* Start all services with restart policies

h3. Monitor Deployment

bc.
# Watch logs in real-time
docker-compose logs -f

# Or watch specific service
docker-compose logs -f dependency-track-apiserver

h3. Verify Services Are Running

bc.
docker-compose ps

Expected output should show all services as "Up" with health status.

h2. Step 6: Verify Services

h3. Check PostgreSQL

bc.
docker-compose exec postgres pg_isready -U dtrack

h3. Check API Server Connection

bc.
docker-compose logs dependency-track-apiserver | grep -i "database\|connected"

h3. Access Web Interfaces

* *DependencyTrack UI*: https://s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com
* *Swagger Editor*: https://s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com/swagger-editor
* *Swagger UI*: https://s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com/swagger-ui

h2. Step 7: Verify Borgmatic Backups

h3. Check Backup Service Logs

bc.
docker-compose logs borgmatic

h3. Manually Trigger Backup

bc.
docker-compose exec borgmatic borgmatic --verbosity 2

h3. Verify Backup Location

bc.
ls -lh /mnt/borg-repository
borg list /mnt/borg-repository

h2. Step 8: Configure LDAP Authentication

DependencyTrack automatically syncs users from LDAP/AD using {{.env}} variables:

* {{LDAP_SERVER_URL}}: LDAPS endpoint
* {{LDAP_BASEDN}}: Root search base
* {{LDAP_BIND_USERNAME}}: Service account username
* {{LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD}}: Service account password
* {{LDAP_USER_GROUPS_FILTER}}: User group membership query
* {{LDAP_TEAM_SYNCHRONIZATION}}: Enabled

Verify LDAP login:
bc.
# Navigate to https://s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com
# Use your AD credentials to login
# Users and teams should sync automatically

h2. Step 9: Volume Backup and Restore

h3. Backup All Volumes

Use the {{backup-and-restore-volume.sh}} script:

bc.
./backup-and-restore-volume.sh backup-all ~/backups/volumes

Creates:
* {{~/backups/volumes/dtrack_postgres_data.tar.gz}}
* {{~/backups/volumes/dtrack_apiserver_data.tar.gz}}
* {{~/backups/volumes/swagger.tar.gz}}

h3. Backup Specific Volume

bc.
./backup-and-restore-volume.sh backup dtrack_postgres_data ~/backups/volumes

h3. Restore All Volumes

bc.
# Stop services
docker-compose down

# Restore volumes
./backup-and-restore-volume.sh restore-all ~/backups/volumes

# Restart services
docker-compose up -d

h3. Restore Specific Volume

bc.
docker-compose down

./backup-and-restore-volume.sh restore dtrack_postgres_data ~/backups/volumes

docker-compose up -d

h2. Step 10: Automated Backups with Borgmatic

The Borgmatic service automatically:
* Runs logical PostgreSQL backups via {{pg_dump}}
* Encrypts backups with {{BORG_PASSPHRASE}}
* Stores on network share at {{/mnt/borg-repository}}
* Maintains retention: 7 daily, 4 weekly, 12 monthly backups

Monitor backups:
bc.
# View logs
docker-compose logs borgmatic

# Check backup repository
borg list /mnt/borg-repository

# List contents of specific archive
borg list /mnt/borg-repository::dtrack-2025-05-06

h2. Step 11: Security Hardening

h3. Post-Deployment: Secure .env

After services are running and verified, secure or destroy the unencrypted .env file:

bc.
# Option 1: Secure directory
chmod 700 .env
sudo chown root:root .env

# Option 2: Destroy (secrets stay available via Docker environment)
rm .env
chmod 700 .

Secrets remain available to containers via environment variables loaded at startup.

h3. Restrict Directory Access

bc.
sudo chown root:root ~/sbom-uploader
sudo chmod 700 ~/sbom-uploader

h2. Step 12: Monitoring and Verification

h3. Check All Services

bc.
docker-compose ps

h3. View Service Logs

bc.
# All services
docker-compose logs

# Specific service
docker-compose logs dependency-track-apiserver --follow
docker-compose logs postgres --follow
docker-compose logs borgmatic --follow

h3. Health Checks

bc.
# PostgreSQL
docker-compose exec postgres pg_isready -U dtrack

# API Server
docker-compose exec dependency-track-apiserver \
  wget -q --spider https://localhost:8080/api/v1/version

h2. Troubleshooting

h3. Services Fail to Start

bc.
# Check logs for errors
docker-compose logs

# Verify .env file exists and has correct values
cat .env

# Verify network mount is accessible
mount | grep borg-repository
ls -la /mnt/borg-repository

h3. Database Connection Failed

bc.
# Check postgres is healthy
docker-compose logs postgres

# Verify database exists
docker-compose exec postgres psql -U dtrack -d dtrack -c "SELECT 1"

# Check network connectivity
docker-compose exec dependency-track-apiserver \
  pg_isready -h postgres -U dtrack

h3. API Server Unable to Connect to DB

bc.
# Verify password is correct in .env
grep POSTGRES_PASSWORD .env

# Check database credentials
docker-compose exec postgres \
  psql -U dtrack -d dtrack -c "SELECT version();"

# Restart API server
docker-compose restart dependency-track-apiserver

h3. Backup Directory Not Accessible

bc.
# Verify mount
mount | grep borg-repository

# If unmounted, remount
sudo mount -t nfs nfs-server:/path/to/borg /mnt/borg-repository
sudo chmod 700 /mnt/borg-repository

# Test borgmatic
docker-compose exec borgmatic borgmatic --verbosity 2

h3. Caddy Certificate Issues

bc.
# Verify certificates exist
ls -la certs/

# Check Caddy logs
docker-compose logs caddy

# If using self-signed, regenerate:
mkdir -p certs
openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \
  -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem \
  -subj "/CN=s-track-01.rdmz.isridev.com"

docker-compose restart caddy

h2. Complete Recovery Example

bc.
# 1. Backup all volumes
./backup-and-restore-volume.sh backup-all /mnt/nas/backups

# 2. If disaster occurs, stop stack
docker-compose down

# 3. Restore volumes
./backup-and-restore-volume.sh restore-all /mnt/nas/backups

# 4. Redeploy
docker-compose up -d

# 5. Verify
docker-compose ps
docker-compose logs -f

h2. Maintenance

h3. Update Services

bc.
# Pull latest images
docker-compose pull

# Restart affected services
docker-compose up -d

h3. Rotate PostgreSQL Password

bc.
# Update .env
nano .env
# Change: POSTGRES_PASSWORD=new-password

# Restart services
docker-compose down
docker-compose up -d

h3. Rotate Backup Encryption

bc.
# Update .env
nano .env
# Change: BORG_PASSPHRASE=new-passphrase

# Old backups keep old passphrase, new ones use new passphrase
docker-compose restart borgmatic

h3. View Service Statistics

bc.
docker stats

h2. Security Model Summary

* *Secrets*: Stored in {{.env}} (encrypted during transfer, secured post-deployment)
* *Storage*: Local volumes persist data across restarts
* *Access*: Directory restricted to root (chmod 700)
* *Transport*: TLS via Caddy reverse proxy
* *Authentication*: LDAP/AD user provisioning and team sync
* *Backups*: Encrypted with BORG_PASSPHRASE on network share
